name: Akane
source:
"The Princess’ enemies are also Akane’s enemies!"

"I’ll gather them all up and take care of it ♡"

She is the half life of the butterfly of the Reine.
Her special features are crying after lying. 
She’s a girly girl and her ideas are always radical.


[from [url=http://cannonette.tumblr.com/post/90743940677/reine-des-fleurs-side-characters]cannonette[/url]]
